title: The WHO mutation catalogue
dek: A graded association between variants and phenotypic DST, not a law of physics. 2nd edition (2023) added BDQ/LZD/DLM alleles. Tools are not the catalogue. Version both.
story: The WHO catalogue of mutations in MTBC grades variants by their association with phenotypic resistance: associated with resistance, associated with resistance — interim, uncertain significance, not associated, not associated — interim (wording varies slightly by edition). It is a public statistical object built from paired WGS+pDST, not a list of “mutations that always fail therapy.”

First edition (2021) was strong on RIF/INH/FQ/AMK and weak on BDQ/LZD/DLM. Second edition (2023) analysed >50,000 isolates and added dozens of BDQ-associated variants, a handful of LZD, and more DLM. Third edition is being fed more Pa and cycloserine data. If your pipeline still grades with 2021, say so — especially for Group A drugs.
TBProfiler, Mykrobe, clockwork, and hospital regexes implement a catalogue (or their own freeze). Discordance between tools is often a version or filter fight, not a new biology.
deepTitle: How to read a grade in clinic
deep: Associated with resistance: count the drug as compromised unless a very good reason not to (mixed AF, contamination).
Uncertain: do not flip a regimen on it alone; add MIC and clinical context.
Not associated: usually phylogenetic. Do not call EMB-R from these.
Absence of a graded variant is not proof of susceptibility when coverage is missing, when AF is filtered, or when the mechanism is incomplete (BDQ without Rv0678 sequenced).

visual.caption: Catalogue as a grading layer sitting on paired WGS+pDST. Tools freeze a version. Clinic consumes grades plus AF, depth, and MIC residual.

example.title: Same BAM, two tool versions
example.setup: 2021-catalogue TBProfiler: BDQ no variants. 2023-catalogue rerun: Rv0678 frameshift associated with resistance.

steps.title: The bacterium did not change

steps.body: Methods: WHO catalogue 2nd ed. 2023, tool X vY. That sentence is DST.

example.takeaway: Catalogue edition is part of the phenotype prediction.

choices: That the variant guarantees clinical failure in every lesion
A graded association with phenotypic resistance, with residual uncertainty
That AF filters are set to 1%
check.answer: A graded association with phenotypic resistance, with residual uncertainty
